notes: SHIP v1.14.378 - TOOLS ART-FIRST CARD FACE, PHONE SHELL. Closes ART-DROP-SHIP-379; .377 shipped its OPS half. Owner ruled: use D5's text, ship the tools half - i.e. proceed from the written spec because phantom-mock-379.html, the John-approved visual target D5 cites, was never delivered. That deviation is recorded here deliberately: the layout below is built from D5's prose and my own reading of the existing card recipe, NOT from an approved mock, so it is the one part of this ship most likely to need a correction pass on device. WHAT SHIPPED: six new rasters (phantom-ref-cli/hwref/know/compass/ghostecho/hardware-768.webp), all sha256-verified against the drop manifest at extraction and re-hashed after rename, all RIFF/WEBP 768x768. Seven #ref-grid cards gain an rf-art class and a --rfimg custom property; the seventh is OPTICS, which reuses phantom-ref-optics-768.webp already shipped in .377 per the owner's earlier ruling. PLATFORMS keeps the existing hardware stem rather than being renamed to platforms - the card is PLATFORMS but its raster has always been phantom-ref-hardware-*, and a gratuitous stem rename is not this ship's business. THE CARD FACE, per D5: art fills the tile via background cover/center, the 96px icon slot is hidden, and the title and dot-separated subtitle collapse to a bottom-left annotation over a local scrim using D5's gradient verbatim - linear-gradient(to top, rgba(4,6,10,.85) 0%, rgba(4,6,10,0) 42%). Subtitle is one line with ellipsis. Per-card --rfac accent, border, corner brackets, :active press and the scan-sweep animation are all untouched. TWO STRUCTURAL DECISIONS WORTH KNOWING. (1) THE SCRIM IS A SECOND BACKGROUND LAYER, NOT A PSEUDO-ELEMENT. Both .rf-card::before AND ::after are already occupied by the scan-sweep rules, so a pseudo-element scrim would have collided with a live animation. Layering the gradient above var(--rfimg) in one background-image declaration avoids touching either. (2) PHONE SHELL ONLY, scoped inside @media (max-width:639.98px). This is D7/R4: the assets are 1:1 and the desktop card runs roughly 2:1, so a desktop cover-crop would discard art - the drop explicitly forbids shipping that as a stopgap. Desktop therefore keeps the v1.14.106 icon-card recipe completely unchanged, which is also why the old -256 rasters are RETAINED and still referenced by each card's img element. Nothing was deleted this ship. The block is scoped to #ref-grid so #work-grid and .deploy-tools-grid, which share the .rf-card class, cannot be affected. Card aspect is set to 1/1 on phone so the square art fits with no crop at all, matching what the OPS wall already does; at a 2-column 390px shell that is about 172x172, well above the 44pt gloved floor, and the whole card remains the tap target with no art layer intercepting. PRECACHE 55 to 61, six entries added. Orphan check clean both directions - 46 referenced paths all exist, and the 21 unreferenced files in icons/ are all pre-existing orphan-but-retained, none from this ship. STILL NOT SHIPPED: ops-deploy-progress.webp, unchanged from .377 - there is no DEPLOY PROGRESS cell on the nine-cell wall and adding an unreferenced 74KB file plus a precache entry would contradict the .364 cleanup. Returned to web-Claude. NOT TOUCHED: the OPS wall (shipped .377), wiring, logic, SAMPLE_STATE, render functions, NAV v2 glyphs, BUILD banners, and ?legacy=1 - the art-first block is body.rd-scoped and legacy never emits rf-art. DEVICE-VERIFY: (1) badge reads v1.14.378. (2) TOOLS page on the PHONE - seven cards should read as art tiles, not icon cards; art edge to edge, no letterboxing, no crop. (3) LEGIBILITY IS THE REAL TEST, and the busiest art is PLATFORMS and CLI - the title and subtitle must stay readable over the scrim; if they do not, the scrim needs strengthening and that is the correction pass. (4) Subtitle must be ONE line with an ellipsis, not wrapped or clipped mid-word - COMPASS and GHOST ECHO have the longest. (5) Tap each of the seven; the whole card must respond and open the same surface as before. (6) ROTATE TO LANDSCAPE or open on the laptop - above 640px the cards must revert to the ORIGINAL icon-card look, unchanged; if desktop shows cropped art that is a regression, revert. (7) OFFLINE PASS: relaunch online once, then airplane-mode and reopen; all seven card arts must still render. (8) ?legacy=1 unchanged. ROLLBACK: revert this commit - restores the icon-card face, removes the six rasters and the six precache entries together. The OPS wall from .377 is unaffected by a revert of this commit.
